acquisition_method.evidence: Both unfractionated and fractionated tumor lysate digests were analyzed using a Q-Exactive, using top10 data-dependent approach.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: A fixed amount (150 μg) of protein were reduced with 10 mM DTT (1 h at 37°C) and alkylated using 40 mM iodoacetamide (30 min, kept dark at room temperature) followed by buffer exchange with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate buffer (pH 7.6).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: A fixed amount (150 μg) of protein were reduced with 10 mM DTT (1 h at 37°C) and alkylated using 40 mM iodoacetamide (30 min, kept dark at room temperature) followed by buffer exchange with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate buffer (pH 7.6).

cleavage_agent.evidence: The samples were then digested with sequencing grade trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI) in a ratio 1:120 w/w (trypsin:protein) overnight at 37°C.

collision_energy.evidence: The ten most intense peaks with charge state≥2 were fragmented in the HCD collision cell with normalized collision energy of 30%, and tandem mass spectra were acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer with resolution 17,500 at m/z 200.

fractionation_method.evidence: Strong cation exchange chromatography was performed using Microspin columns (MA SEM HIL-SCX, 10–100μg capacity, The Nest group Inc., South Borough) according to the manufacturer’s instruction.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The ten most intense peaks with charge state≥2 were fragmented in the HCD collision cell with normalized collision energy of 30%, and tandem mass spectra were acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer with resolution 17,500 at m/z 200.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The samples were first loaded onto a trapping column (150 mm x 20 μm, Thermo Scientific, San José, CA, USA).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Both unfractionated and fractionated tumor lysate digests were analyzed using a Q-Exactive, using top10 data-dependent approach.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Full MS scans were acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer over m/z 350–1800 range with resolution 70,000 (at m/z200).
